fields.name: From
fields.evidence: Game name: ecl::sound::SpeakerAttenuation (ConstructSpeakerAttenuationArray builds StaticArray<SpeakerAttenuation*, 8>). ListenerSpatializationSystem::ProcessSplitScreenViewChanges (EoCClient.dll+0xDAE6E0) computes (p[1] - p[0]) * t + p[0]: value at t = 0. Live: -3, 0 or -18.

fields.name: To
fields.evidence: Value at t = 1 of the same interpolation. Live: 0 or -18.

fields.name: VMT
fields.evidence: Live: a module address (0x7FF7E2B27A40, same in all 3 samples). ProcessSplitScreenViewChanges calls ls::FileFormatIO::Load(singleton, singleton+0x88): the singleton is a FileFormatIO-derived config object.

fields.name: Player1Attenuation
fields.evidence: ConstructSpeakerAttenuationArray((PlayerSpeakerAttenuation*)(singleton+8), ...) - game type ecl::sound::PlayerSpeakerAttenuation, 8 speakers x 8 bytes. Live: (-3,0) (-3,0) (0,0) (0,0) (0,0) (-18,-18) x3.

fields.name: Player2Attenuation
fields.evidence: ConstructSpeakerAttenuationArray((PlayerSpeakerAttenuation*)(singleton+0x48), ...); same live values as the first player.

fields.name: ConfigPath
fields.evidence: ls::Path passed to FileFormatIO::Load (singleton+0x88). Live: heap pointer at +0x88, 0 at +0x90, size 0x90 and capacity 0x9F at +0x98/+0x9C = an ls::STDString (Script Extender STDString, 24 bytes) holding a 144-character file path. Declared as bytes (STDString not an allowed primitive).

fields.name: ListenerCount
fields.evidence: ProcessSplitScreenViewChanges compares the stored count with SoundManager+0x40C (number of sound listeners, asserted <= 2) and stores it. In the Toolkit build it sits at +0xA8 (its ls::Path is 8 bytes larger); in the game build the live value 1 at +0xA0 and the 0xE8 size put it here.

fields.name: Player1Volumes
fields.evidence: Toolkit +0xAC: 8 interpolated speaker values for player 1, zeroed when fewer than 2 listeners, passed to SoundManager vfunc +0x130. Shifted by -8 like ListenerCount. Live: zeros.

fields.name: Player2Volumes
fields.evidence: Toolkit +0xCC: 8 interpolated speaker values for player 2. Shifted by -8. Live: zeros.

open_questions: The 8-byte shift between the Toolkit build (count at +0xA8, floats to +0xEC which would exceed the 0xE8 registry size) and the game build is an inference from live data (+0xA0 = 1); confirm with the game's ProcessSplitScreenViewChanges (bg3.exe, not matched).
ConfigPath is an ls::Path/STDString declared as bytes.
